# Audiline

> Audiline is a free audio news app for Android and iOS. Short, verified news stories
> are read aloud and stitched into one continuous audio news briefing, with a broadcast
> chime between stories, personalized by the categories a listener picks.

## Product

- [Website](https://www.audiline.com/)
- [Download on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.audiline.app)
- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/audiline-short-audio-news/id6799126995)
- [Blog & News](https://www.audiline.com/blog.html)

## Features

- Personalized Daily Brief built from the listener's chosen categories
- Category albums with continuous, ordered playback and heard-story tracking
- Keyword search across every published story, ranked by matching phrases
- Read-along mode: a synced on-screen transcript follows the audio
- Bookmarks, with offline fallback when a saved story has expired
- Background audio with lock-screen, notification and Bluetooth controls
- Adjustable playback speed and a sleep timer
- Android Auto integration: category-only browser and system Now Playing controls
- Apple CarPlay integration: category browser and system Now Playing controls
- Wear OS and Apple Watch companion remotes for the phone's playback queue
